reason: The fail-fast initial run stopped after 145 tests with a controller initial-readiness timeout. A SIGINT was also requested when independent review identified an adjacent restored-evidence mutation; the timeout is retained as a real failed result, not attributed to interruption. The adjacent mutation is now fixed and full validation will be rerun.
diagnosis: Confirmed validation-runner import-path defect, not a production readiness regression. Running a script under the benchmark output directory omitted repository ROOT from sys.path; chdir alone did not add it. FakeCore._pinned_directory lazily imported tests.test_publish, failed before starting a process, and the test timed out waiting for ready. Reproducing that sys.path gave a 4.048s failure, 2286 discovered cases with loader errors; retaining ROOT yielded 2613 cases and all first 145 tests passing. The runner now inserts ROOT explicitly to match python -m unittest and aborts immediately on discovery errors. Production and test timeouts were not changed.

corrected_import_path_verification.description: Independent diagnostic runner, complete discovery followed by the first 145 tests
